blocks.html: MAY FESTIVITY FINALE AT ROBINSONS PLACE MANILA

Robinsons Place Manila in partnership with Ermita-Malate Business Owners Association Inc. (EMBOA) recently held its finale of the month-long festivities with Paseo de Malate and Flores de Ermita event where beautiful maidens of Manila paraded the streets of Ermita and Malate aboard flower adorned horse-drawn carriages. Apart from the traditional Santacruzan, shoppers witnessed the transformation of the Robinsons Place Manila Midtown Atrium into a barrio-inspired setup complete with creative photo opp. corners and fun activities.
The grand Santacruzan was graced by Manila City Mayor Joseph E. Estrada where he gave a brief inspirational message and interacted with the Manila beauty queens.

Robinsons Place Manila and EMBOA share the same passion in revitalizing and uplifting the Ermita-Malate area through initiatives and various activities that will strengthen Manila’s economic, social and cultural environment. Robinsons Place Manila, the only full-service premium mall in the heart of Manila and highly supported by various establishments and organizations, continues to reinvent itself to provide additional values to its growing number of clients and patrons.
